checkedAlternates.risk: Roman law influenced European international law.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Corpus Juris Civilis is the foundational Roman codification of continental Civil Law (group-4), not a modern multilateral treaty (group-1).

checkedAlternates.risk: Geneva Conventions are written codified rules.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The Geneva Conventions bind sovereign states under public international law (group-1), not domestic civil law codes (group-4).
